title: Tween: motionScale=false flag not applied — scale always interpolated
description:
The motionTweenScale flag (decoded from FLA in flash8-binary.ts line 2522, stored as Frame.motionScale) is never applied during tween interpolation.

Two files to fix:

1. packages/core/src/tween/types.ts — Add motionScale?: boolean to TweenConfig interface.

2. packages/core/src/tween/interpolate.ts — In interpolateTween(), when motionScale===false, replace the lerped scaleX/scaleY with the start-frame values (from.scaleX, from.scaleY) instead of interpolating. Same for the 'to' frame: at t=1 still use from.scaleX/from.scaleY since the scale should be frozen.

3. packages/core/src/timeline-query.ts — In getTweenedFrame() (around line 252-305), pass the frame's motionScale flag (from the governing keyframe's motionScale field) into the TweenConfig object.

After fixing, run:
pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run
pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run
Both must pass at current counts.
Commit: fix(tween): respect motionScale=false flag — freeze scale during tween span
